asa_m5_nut_coupon_pass.evidence: Record the ASA hex pocket that fully seats the actual M5 nut without splitting or spinning.

asa_m5_clearance_coupon_pass.evidence: Record the production-axis ASA M5 passage, base-hole, and washer fits.

tag_artwork_scale_pass.evidence: Verify the tag detection edge, tile size, 100% scale, and +Y orientation mark.

board_setup_template_scale_pass.evidence: Select either the released Letter tiled guide or the released 24 x 36 full-size guide, record that PDF path and SHA-256 plus the source workcell-layout SHA-256, and print at Actual Size. Require both independent 100 mm scale bars to measure 100.0 +/- 0.2 mm. For the tiled guide, verify every matching registration mark and the prescribed 12 mm overlaps; for the full-size guide, verify the board-edge, orientation, and scale controls. Do not use an overview, schedule, or assembly-map page as a drilling template.

phone_clamp_rail_first_article_pass.evidence: Inspect Job 03C1 in two stages: first bench-qualify both redesigned captive-nut seats and the 5.6 x 2.2 mm wide-tie saddle, then after Job 03A exists prove the keeper/tower rail seats repeatably, preserves phone side-feature keepouts, and can be replaced without removing the service station.

keyboard_left_first_article_pass.evidence: Inspect cooled job 01 as the pinned master station before releasing the matching slave station.

mast_foot_first_article_pass.evidence: Fully assemble job 07A and verify fit, clamp function, flatness, and no cracks after 24 hours.

keyboard_station_pair_postprint_pass.evidence: Mate cooled jobs 01/02, verify the right station is a seam-located slave with no independent locator pair, and record seam gap, flushness, support-plane flatness, and keyboard dry fit.

keyboard_clamps_postprint_pass.evidence: Inspect both job 03B clamps and their pad interfaces.

phone_tcp_station_postprint_pass.evidence: Inspect the cooled phone/TCP station, including continuous flat base contact at all three retention zones, locator sockets, keyed receiver, fixed phone datums, replaceable-rail interface, and inserts; verify the cable route with the accepted rail-mounted saddle.

tag_application_tool_postprint_pass.evidence: Inspect the reusable job 03C2 application frame for a measured 55.3 mm square opening, flat seating, visible center/+Y witnesses, and clean insertion/removal of an actual square 55 mm tile without corner collision, skew, or lift.

camera_plate_hardware_pass.evidence: Verify the actual camera, screw, T-slot hardware, and straps.

calibration_puck_datum_pass.evidence: Preserve the Job 03D slicer identities: calibration_puck_1 is 03D-A and calibration_puck_2 is 03D-B. Qualify each separately: both require an intact crosshair/divot, lateral play no greater than 0.15 mm, and a mounted-height range no greater than 0.10 mm over ten remove/reinstall cycles. For each accepted cartridge calculate score = max(lateral_play_mm / 0.15, mounted_height_range_mm / 0.10). Label the lower-score cartridge INSTALL; if scores are equal at the measuring resolution, choose the lower height range, then 03D-A if still tied. Label the other accepted cartridge SPARE - TCP RECALIBRATION REQUIRED.

tool_body_postprint_pass.evidence: Inspect the body, caps, inserts, bores, and gripper faces.

stylus_collar_retention_pass.evidence: Use the phone-stylus route values in the PASS tool_force_tcp_limits_approved record, then qualify one collar using measured dry fit or minimal removable compound and a calibrated force gauge. Record the approval ID and prove pull/cycle retention, removability, plastic compatibility and 24-hour creep; confirm no radial screw and retain the second as a labeled spare.

rod_bushing_retention_pass.evidence: Use the keyboard-rod route values in the PASS tool_force_tcp_limits_approved record, qualify one rod bushing with a calibrated force gauge, record the approval ID and 24-hour creep result, and retain the second as a labeled spare.

phone_tpu_batch_postprint_pass.evidence: Inspect and account for all production/spare phone tips.

keyboard_tpu_batch_postprint_pass.evidence: Inspect and account for all production/spare keyboard tips.

mast_second_foot_postprint_pass.evidence: Inspect and fully load the second mast foot using the accepted method.

board_fabrication_pass.evidence: Accept a 610.0 +/- 0.5 x 457.0 +/- 0.5 mm board, 17.50-18.50 mm thick. Front/rear widths and left/right depths may differ by no more than 0.50 mm; both diagonals must be within 1.00 mm of the edge-derived diagonal and within 1.00 mm of each other. Record the independent X and Y printed-template scale checks, the coordinate-transfer audit, local flatness no greater than 0.50 mm, and overall bow no greater than 1.50 mm. For each named locator, record local thickness and a 15.00 +/- 0.20 mm blind depth that preserves at least 2.00 mm local board floor; after pin installation require 5.00 +/- 0.15 mm projection. Both faces and every edge must be evenly sealed and fully cured. Record PASS results for the qualified threaded interface and scrap-stack proof plus the SHA-256 of a fully selected, anchor-specific FASTENER_MAP.csv. Unresolved anchor or bore fields keep this gate from PASS. No router or CNC is required.

keyboard_fixture_assembly_pass.evidence: Pass ten keyboard remove/reinstall cycles with no rocking, seam gap no greater than 0.40 mm, flush mismatch no greater than 0.25 mm, and keyboard pose range no greater than 0.50 mm.

phone_fixture_assembly_pass.evidence: Pass ten phone cycles with pose range no greater than 0.35 mm. Record the approved phone no-go limit ID, approved minimum, measured minimum and uncertainty; the conservative measured margin must meet the approval while button, camera, and USB clearances remain maintained.

tag_direct_installation_pass.evidence: Apply IDs 0-5 directly to the sealed board with full-surface matte adhesive and consistent +Y orientation. Require 55.0 +/- 0.2 mm tile, 40.0 +/- 0.2 mm detection edge, edge lift no greater than 0.20 mm, and 20/20 static detections per tag.

tag_plane_placement_measured.evidence: Record installed XY, yaw, optical-plane Z, the raw edge distances/baselines, and the calculation method for all six direct tags. Require center error within 0.50 mm and yaw within 0.30 degrees. Camera reprojection and static detection are verified separately in Step 13.

station_remove_reinstall_repeatability_p.evidence: Record ten remove/reinstall cycles for keyboard master/slave and phone/TCP stations. Require peak-to-peak X/Y no greater than 0.25 mm, yaw no greater than 0.20 degrees, Z no greater than 0.20 mm, continuous base contact at each retention zone, and no permanent shift after the structural proof load.

tool_force_tcp_limits_approved.evidence: A responsible engineering reviewer must approve every selected route. Each route record must contain at least two compression-force checkpoints (travel_mm, minimum_force_n, maximum_force_n), a positive TCP axis-range limit in mm, and the route-specific rod-bushing/keyboard-TPU or stylus-collar pull force and duration. Record a force-gauge range and resolution in N plus the TCP probe method/frame. Operator-selected arbitrary values are not permitted.

tool_assembled_motion_pass.evidence: For every selected route, record at least 20 cycles, free_travel_mm, one measured force for every approved checkpoint, true full-return/no-coil-bind/gripper-retention/functional-contact results, approved route-specific pull forces and durations, at least ten TCP probes, and X/Y/Z range in mm within the approved scalar axis limit. The approval ID and selected-route/result keys must match exactly.

stylus_function_pass.evidence: Verify capacitive operation by hand and after installation.

commissioning_motion_contact_limits_appr.evidence: Before robot enable, a responsible engineering reviewer must approve positive empty-motion TCP speed (mm/s), TCP acceleration (mm/s^2), minimum clearance (mm), first-contact TCP speed (mm/s), force (N), travel (mm), and 20 N/10 N station-proof durations (s); identify the controller/firmware, E-stop implementation, and board anti-shift implementation; and bind existing project-relative homing/reference, empty-cell motion, and final-process files by SHA-256. First-contact speed may not exceed empty-motion speed. The 50 N axial board-anchor proof remains fixed at 60 seconds.

workcell_commissioning_pass.evidence: Record final loaded-board arm reinforcement and flatness, approved anti-shift and E-stop implementations plus their tests, controller/firmware, the exact hashed homing/reference, empty-cell, and final-process artifacts, locked camera intrinsics and view coverage, board-transform residuals, TCP probe repeatability, approval ID, actual TCP speeds/acceleration in mm/s and mm/s^2, measured force in N, travel/clearance in mm, 20 N/10 N proof durations in s, every 50 N axial/60 s anchor proof, empty-cell clearance, and controlled first contact. Actual motion/contact values must remain within the approved limits.

mast_pair_installation_pass.evidence: Assemble both accepted feet and verify level, plumb, hardware count, and camera stability.
